publications.name: SNU-Avatar Haptic Arm: A Hybrid QDD/DD Operator Interface for Teleoperation
publications.summary: This research presents a 6-DoF haptic arm for immersive teleoperation. Its hybrid quasi-direct-drive and direct-drive architecture balances backdrivability, payload capacity, and force-rendering performance, and was validated through integration with the TOCABI humanoid robot at the ANA Avatar XPRIZE Finals.

publications.name: SNU-Avatar Haptic Glove: Novel Modularized Haptic Glove via Trigonometric Series Elastic Actuators
publications.publisher: 2024 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)
publications.summary: This research develops a haptic glove for realistic avatar-robot teleoperation, integrating Trigonometric SEA–based finger force feedback and a stable middle-phalanx attachment design. A fingertip-position estimation algorithm enables accurate hand-posture sensing without fingertip sensors, improving usability and comfort.

publications.name: SNU-Avatar Robot Hand: Dexterous Robot Hand with Prismatic Four-Bar Linkage for Versatile Daily Applications
publications.publisher: 2023 IEEE-RAS 22nd International Conference on Humanoid Robots
publications.summary: This research presents a robot hand designed for the ANA Avatar XPRIZE, enabling realistic teleoperation through the replication of human actions, gestures, and everyday object manipulation. Using multi–4-bar linkages for single-actuator flexion–extension and compliant AA joints for adaptive grasping, a lightweight four-finger, eight-DoF hand with strong fingertip grip was achieved.

projects.name: Quantum Computing
projects.summary: Quantum computing is the use of quantum-mechanical phenomena such as superposition and entanglement to perform computation. Computers that perform quantum computations are known as quantum computers.
